messages:
Anna S. (support): hitting an escalated report from Acme: tenant acme-123 missing ~12k audit events between 2026-03-01T00:00Z and 2026-03-03T00:00Z. customer says SIEM shows a gap. I grabbed a manifest and one sample S3 key: s3://redwood-prod-audit/acme-123/2026/03/01/part-0001.gz. Can eng-security help triage? :eyes:
Devon R. (eng-security): on it. any chance you have the forwarder logs or the object's metadata? possible KMS wrap issues after alias rotate.
Anna S. (support): here's object GET metadata and error from forwarder (sanitized):
```
HEAD s3://.../part-0001.gz -> 200
GET -> 403 forwarding to SIEM: decrypt failed: EnvelopeDecryptionError: missing cek
x-amz-meta-kms-keyid: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/old-alias
Content-Encoding: gzip
Content-Length: 0
```
Jules K. (eng-exports): hmm content-length 0 + decrypt error means object was uploaded but body empty maybe due to rewrap job failing during KMS alias rotate. We saw a partial rewrap rollout last week. Can we check the reencrypt job logs? :thinking:
eng-kms-bot: alert: alias rotate job completed 2026-03-01T02:15Z, 0 failures recorded by job-runner
Priya S. (eng-sre): I pulled rewrap logs, there are ~1.2k objects where the worker logged but failed to rewrite body due to transient S3 500; backlog retry didn't enqueue for tenant acme-123 due to tenant shard misassignment. Log snippet:
```
ERROR rewrite_worker tenant=acme-123 key=... E=ErrS3Get; wrote 0 bytes; enqueue_rewrite=false
```
Devon R. (eng-security): ok two independent problems: (1) KMS alias rotation + failed rewrap left some objects with old key metadata but body missing, (2) forwarder treats zero-byte as parse fail and drops events. That explains SIEM gap.
Carlos M. (customer-success): customer confirms they changed retention policy on 2026-02-28 from 30d->7d via console; worried some early events expired. They want replay of missing window and assurance it won't happen again.
Priya S. (eng-sre): retention change explains part—older partitions for acme-123 beyond 7d are gone. For the gap within 7d, we can attempt rehydrate from object storage if available; otherwise need replay from producer logs. Steps:
1) run `/scripts/rewrap-reenqueue --tenant acme-123 --since 2026-02-28` to requeue failed rewraps
2) patch forwarder to accept zero-byte buffer and attempt reparse if metadata present (short-term)
3) run targeted backfill job to republish events to SIEM for 2026-03-01..03
Devon R. (eng-security): +1. I'll own patch and add a fallback to log and retry instead of dropping. ETA 48h. :hammer:
Jules K. (eng-exports): I'll enqueue replay for 12k keys. Need support to coordinate with customer for replay window and confirm which events are non-recoverable due to TTL.
Anna S. (support): I told customer we're investigating and will follow up with ETA. They want an interim proof-of-progress by EOD PST.
Priya S. (eng-sre): quick mitigations applied: rewrap enqueue triggered for 2k keys with highest severity, forwarder patched on canary to accept zero-byte and log. Monitoring set for rewrap success rate. :white_check_mark:
Carlos M. (customer-success): Acme acknowledges. Please post PR numbers and replay run id here when ready.
Devon R. (eng-security): PRs: #4127 (forwarder zero-byte retry), #4130 (kms rewrap enqueue fix). Replay run id: replay-20260305-acme-01 (started). Will post progress updates.
Anna S. (support): thanks team. marking this as customer-escalation in jira and assigning follow-ups. Will update acme after first 10% replay.
Priya S. (eng-sre): closing note: retention config UI will get confirmation modal added to prevent accidental shrink. Filed UX ticket #889. :memo:
Anna S. (support): closing thread when replay confirmed and SIEM acked. Thanks everyone.
